message:
I am a super fan of The Colony. John Cohn embodied the pinnacle civilization during his tenure and I have always been inspired by his character since. Every time I watch Season 1, I can't help but find myself compelled into strong emotions when Sam is mentioned. It always seems in life, the most beautiful people, face the most difficult challenges. John and Diane are beacons of light in a dark world. My heart aches deeply for everything that this wonderful family has faced, but at the same moment, it inspired me into a wonderful and positive life. It seems like a lot from a stranger, but the lives of other people can be amazing wisdom for the future. I wanted to request a Sam stone for myself, to share his memory with others when appropriate. I never knew Sam, I never knew John or Diane, but my heart recognized people that make me feel my humanity deeply. I hope to share his story with other people, and of his family. I think one of the most amazing things that I learned from Sam, is that, being a good father or mother, is completely up to you.

I wish you all the best of life and the most peaceful of moments. Thank you being wonderful role models.

Marcus
